Frontend end-to-end: added TEST_TR playlist from https://iptv-org.github.io/iptv/countries/tr.m3u (206 channels, client-side parse), navigated to /epg-timeline, confirmed 23 chips render (Tümü (206) + 22 group chips like Animation;Kids (1), Sports (12), News (26), Undefined (57)), tapped 'Sports' chip → chip becomes active (brandPrimary bg), main list re-renders (empty state message correctly shows 'Bu liste için EPG kaynağı yok. critical_code_review_comments: epg-timeline.tsx line 238 uses `epg-chip-${g}` as testID — for groups containing special chars (e.g. 'Animation;Kids', 'Culture;Education;Lifestyle'), the raw semicolons render into the testID/data-testid attribute. Playwright still matches them, but for TV remote focus tracing or analytics logging you may want to slugify (replace non-alphanum with dash). Not blocking; verified working.

epg-timeline.tsx effect deps at L124 include both `channels` (memoized array) AND `channelIds` (derived from channels). Since channelIds is memo'd off channels, the extra dep is redundant but harmless — React will still only re-run when the memoized reference actually changes.

iptv.ts xtreamNowNextBatch fires up to 8 concurrent fetches to Xtream server; some providers rate-limit aggressively. Consider adding a small delay between waves or reducing default concurrency to 4 for shakier providers. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral in-browser: TEST_TR playlist from https://iptv-org.github.io/iptv/countries/tr.m3u (206 live channels, 22 groups). AsyncStorage-based; cleared on next fresh browser context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real Xtream EPG (xtreamShortEpg base64 decode + xtreamNowNextBatch parallel now/next) can only be validated with a live Xtream provider — code path was verified via imports/structure only, per review request instruction. For public tr.m3u lists without XMLTV epgUrl, the empty state UI is correct behavior (documented in modal). rca_of_issue: BUG 1 (EPG not showing at all): RCA — old epg-timeline only called backend api.epgForChannel which requires XMLTV epgUrl to be set; Xtream playlists never had epgUrl → 0 programs returned. FIX verified: new code branches on isXtream and calls client-side xtreamShortEpg per stream_id (base64-decoded titles). BUG 2 (stuck on first group): RCA — old code loaded EPG once at mount; changing group re-rendered the channel column but the programs map was cached from the original full-channel fetch. FIX verified: useEffect deps now include `[selectedGroup, channels, channelIds]` + cancellation guard `let cancelled = false`; tapping Sports chip triggered a re-fetch and empty state re-evaluated correctly. BUG 3 (format questions): RCA — user was confused about MKV/M3U8/AVI/HTTPS support because there was no in-app documentation. FIX verified: comprehensive Formats modal in settings.tsx L629-663 lists all supported/limited codecs + protocols in Turkish with visual ✅/⚠️ markers.
